text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: <CLIENT_HOME>/Workspaces/site-01/app/deployment-<W2_RUN_RESOURCE_PREFIX>/verification/verify-teardown.py
+"""Read-only verification that deployment cloud resources have been removed."""
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+project = '<CLOUD_PROJECT>'
+queries = {
+    'instances': ['compute', 'instances', 'list'],
+    'disks': ['compute', 'disks', 'list'],
+    'addresses': ['compute', 'addresses', 'list'],
+    'firewall_rules': ['compute', 'firewall-rules', 'list'],
+    'subnets': ['compute', 'networks', 'subnets', 'list'],
+    'networks': ['compute', 'networks', 'list'],
+    'routes': ['compute', 'routes', 'list'],
+    'snapshots': ['compute', 'snapshots', 'list'],
+    'custom_images': ['compute', 'images', 'list', '--no-standard-images'],
+    'project_metadata': ['compute', 'project-info', 'describe'],
+}
+
+def read(item):
+    kind, args = item
+    result = subprocess.run(['gcloud'] + args + ['--project=' + project, '--format=json'],
+                            check=True, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
+    data = json.loads(result.stdout)
+    if kind == 'project_metadata':
+        key = Path('<CLIENT_HOME>/.ssh/google_compute_engine.pub').read_text().split()[1]
+        entries = [line for entry in data.get('commonInstanceMetadata', {}).get('items', [])
+                   if entry['key'] == 'ssh-keys' for line in entry.get('value', '').splitlines()]
+        remaining = [line.split(':', 1)[0] for line in entries
+                     if line.startswith('<ACCOUNT>:') and len(line.split()) >= 2 and line.split()[1] == key]
+    else:
+        remaining = [entry['name'] for entry in data
+                     if entry.get('name', '').startswith('<W2_RUN_RESOURCE_PREFIX>-')
+                     or entry.get('network', '').endswith('/networks/<W2_RUN_RESOURCE_PREFIX>-network')
+                     or entry.get('sourceDisk', '').endswith(('/disks/<W2_RUN_RESOURCE_PREFIX>-alerta', '/disks/<W2_RUN_RESOURCE_PREFIX>-data'))]
+    return kind, remaining
+
+with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as executor:
+    results = dict(executor.map(read, queries.items()))
+report = {'project': project, 'verified_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+          'remaining_deployment_resources': results,
+          'status': 'passed' if not any(results.values()) else 'failed'}
+path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'teardown.json'
+path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
+print(json.dumps(report))
+if report['status'] != 'passed':
+    raise SystemExit('Some deployment resources remain.')
*** End Patch"));
const results=await Promise.allSettled([
tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 deployment-<W2_RUN_RESOURCE_PREFIX>/verification/verify-teardown.py","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I independently verify that every deployment resource and the deployment SSH metadata entry are gone?","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":2500}),
tools.exec_command({cmd:"dig @<IP_ADDRESS_098> <W2_RUN_HOST_LABEL>.<EXPERIMENT_DOMAIN> A +noall +answer +authority +comments; dig @<IP_ADDRESS_105> <W2_RUN_HOST_LABEL>.<EXPERIMENT_DOMAIN> A +noall +answer +authority +comments","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I confirm directly with Cloudflare’s authoritative DNS servers that the deployment A record has been removed?","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":2000})
]);results.forEach(text);
